title: TubeLight
description: Replaces the End Rod with a modern tube light using a custom model and texture.
body:
# TubeLight

TubeLight is a simple resource pack that replaces the vanilla End Rod with a sleek modern tube light, featuring a custom 3D model and texture. Perfect for adding clean, modern lighting to your builds while keeping the original functionality unchanged.

![Overview](https://i.imgur.com/SW6qNbP.png)
